Game Overview

Ninja Blocks is a racing title where unleash your inner ninja in Ninja Blocks, a strategic action game where precision and timing are key. Launch your ninja to topple enemy structures, create chain reactions, and progress through pixel-art worlds. Save the kidnapped princess while mastering increasingly complex levels and revel in retro-style fun.
